import math
import time


def primes_up_to(limit):
    phase_start = time.process_time_ns()
    is_prime = bytearray(b"\x01") * (limit + 1)
    is_prime[:2] = b"\x00\x00"
    init_done = time.process_time_ns()
    for candidate in range(2, math.isqrt(limit) + 1):
        if is_prime[candidate]:
            start = candidate * candidate
            is_prime[start::candidate] = bytes((limit - start) // candidate + 1)
    marking_done = time.process_time_ns()
    result = sum(is_prime)
    counting_done = time.process_time_ns()
    print(init_done - phase_start)
    print(marking_done - init_done)
    print(counting_done - marking_done)
    return result


def bench():
    started = time.process_time_ns()
    result = primes_up_to(20_000)

    elapsed = time.process_time_ns() - started
    print(result)
    print(elapsed)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    bench()
